newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: First Capital unit buys S$42 mln property.
newsitem.headline: First Capital unit buys S$42 mln property.

text.p: Property group First Capital Corp said on Tuesday its subsidiary Fasidon Holdings Pte Ltd had signed an agreement to buy a freehold property in Singapore for S$41.64 million.
The agreement was signed with the executors of the estate of Injo Lioe Kho Nio for the property in a prime residential district, First Capital said in a statement.
First Capital plans to turn the 4,421.1 sq metre property into a four-storey condominium that would incorporate an existing conservation bungalow.
It said a deposit of S$4.164 million had been paid and the balance would be paid on completion of the deal. The acquisition would be financed from internal resources and bank borrowings, it said.
First Capital said the purchase would not affect the group's net tangible asset per share or earnings per share in the current financial year.
